title.narrative: Supporting the treatment of cancer patients from the Gaza Strip in Jordan

description.narrative: Providing full or partial coverage for the treatment of patients from the batch of patients received from Gaza at the Hussein Cancer Center, and providing coverage amounts within a specific period of time that ensures smooth procedures for patients to receive their treatment without any interruption, and covering the costs of living, including accommodation and 3 meals per day for the patient and his companions.

Providing the best health care for cancer patients from Gaza and treating them after the will of God Almighty by developing a comprehensive treatment plan with providing psychological care for patients, and working to evacuate patients from the Gaza Strip and their companions and securing accommodation and meals, as the coverage rate of the proposed project is 30% of the total expected need.

To save the largest possible number of cancer patients from Gaza who are unable to cover the costs of their treatment, and who have been deprived of the opportunity for treatment due to the complete collapse of the health system.
